Lemmy the gnome is a character that has been featured in several official World of Warcraft trailers. His first appearance was in [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TaBYjVBY_bM Wish You Were Here], a trailer advertising the level 90 Character Boost. In it, Lemmy is stranded in the Tanaris desert. He receives a letter from his friends inviting him to raids, but the gnome becomes saddened when he realizes that the raids require him to be level 90, and he is currently only level 61. However, he then sees another letter offering a level 90 character boost. Lemmy signs his name and boosts to level 90, gaining new armor (and a new mustache) and is transported to the Siege of Orgrimmar in the process

Leran was a draenei and the sister of Vindicator Maraad on Draenor. After being tricked by Gul'dan, the Bladewind clan of orcs formed raiding parties and began attacking draenei caravans. They killed dozens of draenei and captured even more. Among the prisoners was Leran. Draenei scouts reported the Bladewind sacrificing their prisoners in gruesome rituals to appease the elements and Maraad urged the draenei to save the prisoners, his sister included. He led the assault on the Bladewind, but by the time they arrived, Leran and the others were dead. The sight of his sister's body sent Maraad into a rage and he rampaged through the village. Levitate is a priest utility spell that allows the target to levitate, reducing the rate of fall and allowing on-foot travel over water and water-like surfaces. Levitate cannot be cast upon mounted targets, and mounting will cancel the effect, as will any damage. Although not obviously the most useful of spells, players have found a wide variety of uses for Levitate, be it in combat, for traveling or simply for entertainment.

He also appeared in Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds reporting to Loon Mai when the Ik'thik mantid breached the Serpent's Spine. Loon Mai commanded him to go fight the mantid. Leven was soon assisted by Chen Stormstout. Considering his ornate armor, how he appeared to take command of the forces of the vale at several points, and the part he played in the finale of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms storyline, he may have been the military commander of the Golden Lotus.
